sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Bicske–Székesfehérvár railway as MÁV line 6 and explicitly lists Székesfehérvár in its route diagram. The article cites extensive railway-history, regional-press and book sources; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source was used for the reviewed line-membership fact.
sharedSource.caveat: The page is marked as under construction and the individual route row has no separate inline citation; this is disclosed for human review.
